name: codex-security
description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security
one_liner: A tool that scans your code for security holes, explains each one in plain language, and can write the fix itself — like having a security expert review every commit.
buyer: A CTO at a seed-to-Series-B startup with no dedicated security engineer who needs to pass a customer's security questionnaire or a SOC 2 audit.
business_use_cases: A startup runs it as a GitHub Action on every pull request so vulnerabilities get caught and auto-fixed before merge, standing in for a security hire they can't afford yet.
A security consultancy uses it to triage a new client's codebase fast, then bills for the human judgment layered on top of the automated findings.
A company preparing for a SOC 2 or vendor-security review runs it to clean up and document findings ahead of the audit.

money_ideas.idea: Sell 'scan-as-a-service' with scheduled runs, dashboards, and alerts instead of just a raw CLI
Build a compliance-report generator on top that turns scan results into SOC2/PCI-style write-ups for startups prepping for audits

steal_this: Wrap it in a simple web dashboard that scans connected repos nightly and emails a weekly 'security score' report — sell it to small startups as a $50/month safety net.
